titles.title: unselected clients are always emitted as skipped, never omitted
{claude:true} registers claude (mcp add --scope user); codex is skipped
{agents:true} maps to the codex client (agents flag → codex, --scope omitted)
{vibe:true} registers vibe via `vibe mcp add insrc --transport stdio`; no `mcp list` is spawned
vibe already present in config.toml [[mcp_servers]] → unchanged, no add spawned
vibe add failure → failed carrying the CLI stderr; other clients unaffected
upsertVibeAgentsSteering: creates AGENTS.md with the marked steering block when absent, idempotent on second call
upsertVibeAgentsSteering: replaces only the marked span on re-registration (future release updates content in place), preserves surrounding user content
upsertVibeAgentsSteering: malformed markers (open without close) are a guarded no-op — file untouched, never clobbered
registerMcpClients with {vibe:true} also upserts the AGENTS.md steering block (in-memory seam), and registration still succeeds
vibeConfigHasServer: matches an [[mcp_servers]] name line only, not other tables or values
an existing `insrc` entry in `mcp list` → unchanged, no add spawned
an `insrc` substring only inside a path (not a line-start name) does NOT count as registered
an indeterminate `mcp list` (non-zero exit) → failed, and deliberately does NOT add
a missing CLI binary (ENOENT spawn) → failed with a not-found note, no throw
a non-zero `mcp add` exit → failed carrying the CLI stderr
per-client isolation: claude add fails, codex still registers independently
mixed idempotency: claude already present, codex absent → unchanged + registered
a missing out/bin/insrc-mcp.js → failed for each selected client, no subprocess
registerMcpClients never rejects even if the injected run throws
probeMcpClients: per-client availability + registration from the same pre-checks registration uses; never throws
probeMcpClients: an unreachable CLI resolves available:false, registered:false; a vibe without config text is registered:false
vibe + repoPath registers in the USER-GLOBAL config via `vibe mcp add`, never writes the repo's .vibe/config.toml
vibe + repoPath: a legacy project-layer insrc entry is removed; the file is deleted when nothing else remains
vibe + repoPath: a legacy insrc chunk is removed while other servers and settings are preserved
vibe + repoPath: legacy cleanup runs even when the user-global entry already exists (action unchanged)
vibe + repoPath: a project config without an insrc entry is left untouched
vibe + repoPath: a cleanup failure never fails the registration
vibe + repoPath: an unfixable project config (mcp_servers not a list) never fails the registration
vibe without repoPath keeps the user-global `vibe mcp add` path (unchanged behavior)
probeMcpClients reads the USER-GLOBAL config for vibe; a project-layer entry no longer counts (ISSUE-767aef145a1b22ef)
removeVibeProjectServer on a real temp dir: deletes a config that held only the insrc entry; preserves one with more content
removeVibeProjectServer moves an inline mcp_servers list to tables and drops only the insrc entry
removeVibeProjectServer deletes a config whose only content was an inline insrc entry with a quoted name key
removeVibeProjectServer drops a config holding both forms (empty inline list + insrc table) entirely
removeVibeProjectServer keeps an unrelated single-table section that follows the insrc entry
removeVibeProjectServer keeps later [[mcp_servers]] tables when a single-table section follows the removed entry
removeVibeProjectServer does not mistake a `name = "insrc"` field inside a later table for the server entry
removeVibeProjectServer drops a real insrc entry even when a later table also carries `name = "insrc"`
removeVibeProjectServer drops the entry's own [mcp_servers.env] sub-table with it, leaving a preceding server intact
removeVibeProjectServer keeps an unrelated table between the entry and its sub-table
removeVibeProjectServer keeps sub-table-free unrelated tables after a mixed chunk
removeVibeProjectServer keeps a quoted root table whose name merely contains a dot
removeVibeProjectServer drops the entry's sub-table when its first component is quoted
removeVibeProjectServer keeps a quoted table name containing #
removeVibeProjectServer ignores a `name = "insrc"` line inside a multiline string value
removeVibeProjectServer byte-preserves multiline strings in kept entries while dropping a genuine insrc entry
removeVibeProjectServer ignores a fake [[table]] line inside a multiline string when finding chunk boundaries
removeVibeProjectServer treats quotes inside comments as plain text
removeVibeProjectServer does not close a multiline basic string at an escaped quote before a fence run
removeVibeProjectServer ignores a line-continuation backslash inside a multiline basic string
removeVibeProjectServer keeps an indented [[mcp_servers]] element inside the removed chunk, sub-tables included
removeVibeProjectServer leaves a config it cannot normalize untouched and reports the failure
